subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should OpenClaw keep this broad issue as the canonical core tracker, and which remaining WebChat project-directory and multi-AI collaboration pieces belong in core versus plugin/ClawHub/API-extension work?
rationale: Current main covers many session-management primitives, but the remaining committee/project workflow crosses product UX, Gateway protocol/storage, and orchestration boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and create maintainer-scoped milestones for project/session metadata, Control UI directory UX, and multi-agent collaboration semantics.

options.title: Narrow To Session UX
options.body: Declare the broad committee/project-tracking direction out of scope for now and keep only the remaining session-directory pieces in core.

options.title: Close As Satisfied
options.body: Treat current sidebar, grouping, archive, search, fork, and subagent primitives as enough, accepting that committee/project workflows remain untracked here.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and create maintainer-scoped milestones for project/session metadata, Control UI directory UX, and multi-agent collaboration semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the canonical-tracker signal and authored the latest adjacent session-sidebar grouping work.
